# BCGov Crow - v0.7.7

## Release type

Patch

## Summary

Aligns Crow's testing guidance and templates so manual QA scope, integration
scenario applicability, and work-item tracking use consistent instructions.

## Highlights

- Clarifies how shared UI changes should identify a representative manual QA
  sample and its selection rationale.
- Treats absent external dependency or proof scenarios consistently by omitting
  them from scenario documents.
- Standardizes work-item tracking values across testing-plan and scenario
  templates.

## Changes

- Updated the testing guidance and templates introduced in the 0.7.6 release
  to remove conflicting scenario instructions.
- Added the representative-sample requirement to the manual coverage register
  fields.
- Synchronized version references and installation examples for the 0.7.7
  package.

## Validation

- Crow asset validation: 0 errors, 0 warnings
- Package dry run: passed; 149 files selected for the 0.7.7 archive
- Archive inspection: passed; package contents contain no local state or
  evidence directories
- Additional checks: `git diff --check`, Crow release guards, project
  configuration tests, and Sonar quality gate passed

## Installation

Install the tagged release globally:

```powershell
apm install bcgov/crow#v0.7.7 --global --target copilot
```

Or install the packaged archive:

```powershell
apm install .\build\bcgov-crow-0.7.7.zip --global --target copilot
```
